g.text: Validate order request (fields, types, business rules)
Check buying power, holdings, price bands, limits
If validation fails, return error to user
Validate input, create Order (status=Pending), persist in DB
Simulate/execute order, determine fill status, price
Update order in DB, enforce state transitions
Update user balance, persist in DB
HTTP 201 Created (Order details, status, execution info)
API Gateway orchestrates all steps, handles errors, and returns final result
All service calls are synchronous HTTP requests, each service validates and persists its own data
